{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse with a relaxed collar, soft drape cut, ivory color (#fdfdfd), fine woven fabric.
Tailored wide-leg trousers, tapered leg cut, midi length, charcoal heather gray (#36454f), heavy wool blend.
Strappy gold sandals, open-toe cut, ankle height, metallic champagne gold (#f7e7ce), smooth leather with dangling chains matching the requested necklace style.

This outfit balances the relaxed "everyday" formality requirement for a restaurant dinner while incorporating her wish for golden hanging jewelry through both the necklace and the sandal details. The ivory silk blouse provides a soft contrast to the charcoal trousers, creating an elegant yet comfortable look suitable for autumn weather without needing an outer layer. The silhouette is flattering and polished enough for an upscale setting without crossing into formal territory, honoring her desire for a calm mood."}
